mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(sale_time) = CURRENT_DATE THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS today_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_time) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_time) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_amount FROM shop_sale_record

SELECT -- 今日统计 SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(sale_time)=CURRENT_DATE THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS today_sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(sale_time)=CURRENT_DATE THEN profit ELSE 0 END) AS today_profit, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(sale_time)=CURRENT_DATE THEN id END) AS today_order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(sale_time)=CURRENT_DATE THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS today_sale_qty, -- 自然月 SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',sale_time)=DATE_TRUNC('month',CURRENT_DATE) THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_sale_amount, -- 自然季度 SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('quarter',sale_time)=DATE_TRUNC('quarter',CURRENT_DATE) THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS quarter_sale_amount, -- 自然年 SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('year',sale_time)=DATE_TRUNC('year',CURRENT_DATE) THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS year_sale_amount FROM shop_sale_record WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_time) = #{year}
SELECT product_name,SUM(quantity) as sale_count FROM shop_sale_record WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_time) = #{year} GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY sale_count DESC LIMIT 5
